meta.title: STC Recharge
meta.description: Demo portal to recharge a Saudi mobile number, buy packages, pay bills, and redeem vouchers.

home.demoNote: Demo rules: a number ending in 0000 fails after payment. A number ending in 1111 has a 150 KWD bill. Voucher code STC-DEMO-5000.

support.title: Support
support.subtitle: Answers about this demo portal, and a form that stores a ticket.
support.faq1q: Is this the real operator payment site?
support.faq1a: No. This is a local demo. The pay button simulates a hosted checkout and does not charge a card.
support.faq2a: Any Saudi mobile number in the form 05xxxxxxxx. Numbers ending in 0000 fail fulfillment. Numbers ending in 1111 show a bill.
support.faq3a: Open the checkout page for the order, or sign in and look under Account.
